newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai cabinet removes top finance ministry official.
newsitem.headline: Thai cabinet removes top finance ministry official.

text.p: The Thai cabinet on Tuesday transferred to an inactive post outspoken permanent secretary for finance Chatumongkol Sonakul, deputy interior minister Chalerm Yubamrung said.
Chatumongkol's transfer came less than one day after Bank of Thailand governor Rerngchai Marakanond tendered his resignation. Chatumongkol was the most senior civil servant at the ministry.

Chatumongkol has previously called on the government to cut budgets and embrace additional fiscal and monetary discipline as the country adjusted to its most severe economic crisis in more than a decade.

Chalerm told reporters after a special cabinet meeting in this northern province that the permanent secretary was transferred to an unspecified job at Government House and he would be temporarily replaced by his deputy, Supachai Pisitvanich.
